title: Turo no Awɛmfo
intro: Wɔ turo bi a ɛso yɛ frɔmfrɔm mu no, mpɔtam hɔfo bi hyɛɛ bɔ a anibere wom. Nanso wɔsɔɔ wɔn bo a wɔasi no hwɛe bere a ɔsoro apɛde de ne ho gyee mu, na ɛdanee wɔn adom no yɛɛ no ​​asase a ɛso yɛ kwa no.
clues: Wɔhyiraa yɛn turo a ɛdɔɔso, nanso yɛbɛyɛɛ ahantanfo.
Yɛyɛɛ nhyehyɛe sɛ yebetwa otwa a yɛne ahiafo renkyɛ.
Yesiim anɔpatutuutu, na na yɛwɔ yɛn nhyehyɛe no mu ahotoso.
Nanso bere a yeduu hɔ no, yehui sɛ wɔasɛe yɛn turo no anadwo biako pɛ.
Yehuu yɛn mfomso na yefii ase de asodi no too yɛn ho yɛn ho so.
Awiei koraa no, yenu yɛn ho, nanso yesuaa asuade no akyiri dodo.

arabic: إِنَّا بَلَوْنَـٰهُمْ كَمَا بَلَوْنَآ أَصْحَـٰبَ ٱلْجَنَّةِ إِذْ أَقْسَمُوا۟ لَيَصْرِمُنَّهَا مُصْبِحِينَ
verse: Indeed, We have tried them as We tried the companions of the garden, when they swore to cut its fruit in the [early] morning (68:17)
